name: celestial-catalog
description: CRUD fullstack d'objets célestes : API Express + SQLite, client React + MUI

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
